ns2:course.label: Turbulence
ns2:course.description: (T A M 438) Instability and origins of chaotic motion in fluid flow; Reynolds averaging and statistical description of turbulence, correlations and spectral dynamics of homogeneous turbulence, anisotropic flows, coherent structures, inhomogeneous turbulence, transport models, large-eddy simulations Prerequisite: TAM 532.
